data.exact_reserve_text: The prior accident year experience has been less benign. Deterioration on the earned and booked position on some accounts has had a negative impact on the Syndicate's result for the year. In particular, deterioration on certain Marine Insurance segments has dragged back the performance of this class. The legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio, from which the Syndicate has now exited, also exhibited some deterioration in the first half of the calendar year based on claims development on prior years' exposures. Recent development has been more stable but reserves have nonetheless been strengthened.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Deterioration on earned and booked position of certain Marine Insurance segments.
Deterioration in legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio based on claims development on prior years' exposures, leading to strengthened reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced an overall strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 11.763 million in 2015. This was primarily driven by deterioration in certain Marine Insurance segments and the legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio, which required reserves to be strengthened.

data.data_quality_notes: The 'Claims incurred in prior accident years' line in Note 11 (page 41) shows a gross release of GBP 289.988m, which contradicts the claims development triangle and narrative. The prior year development amount is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 48) as the change in ultimate estimates for underwriting years 2012 and 2013, which aligns with the narrative of deterioration.
